PQ gate on inline remote neighbors, same index and flags, 2026-10-14.
Every machine holds PQ codes of all 1M base vectors (tests/index/pq_encode,
256 centers, 100k random training sample). With top-ef full, an inline
neighbor on another machine (group size <= INLINE_DEG_BAR) is not READ
from a non-core machine, or sent to a core machine, when its PQ distance
exceeds lowerBound * (1 + tau). Survivors still get the exact distance.
Out-of-line groups and node-expansion tasks are not gated.
Runs: base (no PQ), shadow (PQ32 loaded, tau < 0, counts only),
pq32 (32 B/vector, tau 0), pq16 (16 B/vector, tau 0).
Logs: tmp/sift1m-4p/logs/{pq-base,pq32-shadow,pq32-tau0,pq16-tau0}/
Tables: python3 scripts/softroce/comm_table.py <log dir> 4 --types --chan --at ...
